items.quote: Mac did an excellent job fixing our electrical box. He is very skillful and cared about doing more than necessary to make sure everything worked. My husband and I highly recommend him. Old school honest and reliable are adjectives I would use to describe him.

Mac is incredible! He is a problem solver and will help correct electrical issues that are safest, least invasive and most economical. He will not sell you something you don't need. He is honest, trustworthy, reasonably priced and a great human being.

I have worked with McCullough Electrical Concepts a number of time for my home electrical needs. They are always straight forward, honest and do great work. I highly recommend them and will always call them for anything electrical.
